trial.q: Can I try it for free?
trial.a: Yes. The account and editing are free, and every plan has a trial period. We charge only after it ends.

publish.q: Do I have to pay to build a site?
publish.a: No. A paid plan is needed only to publish the site at a public address.

cancel.a: Cancel the subscription in the panel under Billing. The plan stays active until the end of the paid period.

invoices.a: Yes, every payment gets a VAT invoice, sent to KSeF and by email. Enter your billing details (including a company tax ID) in the panel.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Higher plans let you connect your own domain or buy a new one in the panel. The domain stays yours, also after changing the plan.

data.a: Download or delete your data any time in the account settings. Details in the privacy policy.
